'''Palsaang''' was a [[city]] located on [[Kashyyyk]], a [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] that was [[homeworld]] of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Wookiee]] [[species]].<ref name="BMF 43" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Palsaang was introduced in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 43|forty-third]] issue of the [[De Agostini]] ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF 43" /> which was published around [[October 28]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|43}}</ref> The [[Palsaang/Legends|city]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[Republic 81|eighty-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was the first in the [[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy|''Hidden Enemy'']] arc and was written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Hidden Enemy">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''</ref> and released on [[January 4]], [[2006]].<ref name="Release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54527/star_wars_republic_2002_81|text=Star Wars: Republic (2002) #81}}</ref>
